title: "Don't show minimized" visibility option
line: The Task Manager can now be set to show only windows that are not minimized.
explanation: The Task Manager's Behavior settings offered "Show only tasks that are minimized" but no opposite, so you couldn't set up one task manager for visible windows and another for minimized ones. The task model already supported this filter (filterMinimized); only the setting and its checkbox were missing. The change adds a hideMinimized setting bound to that filter and a "That are not minimized" checkbox under "Show only tasks:"; it and "That are minimized" uncheck each other, since together they would hide every window.

commits.message:
applets/taskmanager: add option to show only tasks that are not minimized

The task manager could be set to show only minimized tasks, but not the
opposite, so two task managers couldn't split visible and minimized
windows between them. This adds a "That are not minimized" checkbox.

BUG: 520356

patches.diff:
From 042ef2a638616dd24fa5d6936e227a4c599002f0 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 19:57:44 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/taskmanager: add option to show only tasks that are
 not minimized

The task manager could be set to show only minimized tasks, but not the
opposite, so two task managers couldn't split visible and minimized
windows between them. This adds a "That are not minimized" checkbox.

BUG: 520356
---
 applets/taskmanager/main.xml               |  4 ++++
 applets/taskmanager/qml/ConfigBehavior.qml | 16 ++++++++++++++++
 applets/taskmanager/qml/main.qml           |  1 +
 3 files changed, 21 insertions(+)

diff --git a/applets/taskmanager/main.xml b/applets/taskmanager/main.xml
index 8c3b68785b..ae6ec81106 100644
--- a/applets/taskmanager/main.xml
+++ b/applets/taskmanager/main.xml
@@ -22,6 +22,10 @@
       <label>Whether to show only window tasks that are minmized.</label>
       <default>false</default>
     </entry>
+    <entry name="hideMinimized" type="Bool">
+      <label>Whether to show only window tasks that are not minimized.</label>
+      <default>false</default>
+    </entry>
     <entry name="unhideOnAttention" type="Bool">
       <label>Whether to unhide if a window wants attention.</label>
       <default>true</default>
diff --git a/applets/taskmanager/qml/ConfigBehavior.qml b/applets/taskmanager/qml/ConfigBehavior.qml
index bd4b7cf008..3d7cadd821 100644
--- a/applets/taskmanager/qml/ConfigBehavior.qml
+++ b/applets/taskmanager/qml/ConfigBehavior.qml
@@ -33,6 +33,7 @@ KCMUtils.SimpleKCM {
     property alias cfg_showOnlyCurrentDesktop: showOnlyCurrentDesktop.checked
     property alias cfg_showOnlyCurrentActivity: showOnlyCurrentActivity.checked
     property alias cfg_showOnlyMinimized: showOnlyMinimized.checked
+    property alias cfg_hideMinimized: hideMinimized.checked
     property alias cfg_minimizeActiveTaskOnClick: minimizeActive.checked
     property alias cfg_unhideOnAttention: unhideOnAttention.checked
     property alias cfg_reverseMode: reverseMode.checked
@@ -246,6 +247,21 @@ KCMUtils.SimpleKCM {
         QQC2.CheckBox {
             id: showOnlyMinimized
             text: i18nc("@option:check completes sentence: show only tasks", "That are minimized")
+            onToggled: {
+                if (checked) {
+                    hideMinimized.checked = false;
+                }
+            }
+        }
+
+        QQC2.CheckBox {
+            id: hideMinimized
+            text: i18nc("@option:check completes sentence: show only tasks", "That are not minimized")
+            onToggled: {
+                if (checked) {
+                    showOnlyMinimized.checked = false;
+                }
+            }
         }
 
         Item {
diff --git a/applets/taskmanager/qml/main.qml b/applets/taskmanager/qml/main.qml
index d0a62d21bc..81e04d3d59 100644
--- a/applets/taskmanager/qml/main.qml
+++ b/applets/taskmanager/qml/main.qml
@@ -168,6 +168,7 @@ PlasmoidItem {
         filterByScreen: Plasmoid.configuration.showOnlyCurrentScreen
         filterByActivity: Plasmoid.configuration.showOnlyCurrentActivity
         filterNotMinimized: Plasmoid.configuration.showOnlyMinimized
+        filterMinimized: Plasmoid.configuration.hideMinimized
 
         hideActivatedLaunchers: tasks.iconsOnly || Plasmoid.configuration.hideLauncherOnStart
         sortMode: sortModeEnumValue(Plasmoid.configuration.sortingStrategy)
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Behavior settings on master: only "That are minimized" is offered.
With the fix: new "That are not minimized" checkbox.
Master: minimized Dolphin still shows as a running task.
"That are not minimized" on: minimized Dolphin is hidden, only its pinned launcher stays.
With the option on, Konsole shows while its window is visible…
…and disappears from the task manager when it is minimized.

reviews.text: Minimal, clean change that exposes libtaskmanager's existing filterMinimized property via a new hideMinimized KConfig entry and a mutually exclusive 'That are not minimized' checkbox under 'Show only tasks:' in ConfigBehavior.qml. It requires no config migration, follows existing i18n and QML conventions, and is clearly verified with before/after screenshots for both the settings UI and runtime task filtering.

Gives the reporter exactly the requested opposite of 'That are minimized', so two task managers can split visible and minimized windows. It is a small, clean change in the right place: libtaskmanager's TasksModel already exposes filterMinimized, and the patch only adds the hideMinimized key, the binding in main.qml and a checkbox in the existing 'Show only tasks:' group. Screenshots show the new checkbox and Konsole leaving the panel when minimized. Nits: two checkboxes that uncheck each other are a mild HIG stretch (a maintainer could ask for a radio/combobox instead), and before-3.png is tagged 'before' although it shows the fixed build with the option on. Neither blocks the MR.
